name: Domo
dof_breakdown: 23 DOF on the 90 cm model; a 130 cm / 35 kg version has 25
summary: A Silicon Valley startup's answer to the price floor: an untethered developer humanoid from $2,999, with battery, compute, sensors and motor control all inside a fully enclosed aluminum shell and no wiring hanging out. Sold in 90 cm and 130 cm sizes for teleoperation, imitation and reinforcement-learning work.
